title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Boosts Astra Rate Limits & Rate Resets: OpenAI bumped 5-hour Astra limits by ~50% across all tier plans and issued a full weekly usage reset, with developers praising Astra-Medium for matching GPT-5.6 intelligence at 1/3 the cost.

Artificial Analysis Debuts Intelligence Index v4.2: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 leads the updated AA benchmark index ahead of GPT-6 Astra, with both models setting new benchmarks for real-world software reverse engineering (SRE-Bench).

Sam Altman Clarifies Cybersecurity Pause on Bloomberg: Altman confirmed GPT-6 Astra is fully deployed and that the model recently paused over cyber safety concerns is an upcoming unreleased frontier iteration.

August Jobs Report Triggers Fed Rate Hike Re-Evaluation: August US non-farm payroll additions nearly tripled forecasts, causing markets to price in a potential 25 bps Federal Reserve interest rate increase.
Mbappé Misses 95th-Min Penalty in Real Betis Stunner: Kylian Mbappé failed to convert a late penalty in stoppage time as Real Betis held on for a dramatic victory over Real Madrid.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Rolls Out Weekly Usage Reset and Astra Limits Boost
items.body: OpenAI product leads confirmed a full usage reset for Plus, Pro, and Business plans alongside a ~50% increase in 5-hour Astra message limits.

items.title: @ArtificialAnlys: Artificial Analysis Index v4.2 Ranks Fable 5.1 & Astra at Top
items.body: Artificial Analysis launched Index v4.2 with new agentic knowledge benchmarks (AA-Briefcase, GDP.pdf), showing Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra leading the frontier.

items.title: @rohanpaul_ai: Sam Altman Clarifies Paused Frontier Model vs Astra Deployment
items.body: Sam Altman stated on Bloomberg TV that Astra completed safety checks for deployment, while the model recently paused for cyber-critical evaluation is a future model.

items.title: @PawelHuryn: Real-World Bug Sweep Benchmark Ranks Astra (48/105) Ahead of Fable 5.1
items.body: Independent benchmark testing across real software repositories showed Astra resolving 48 of 105 bugs with superior time and token efficiency.

items.title: @i2huer: GPT-6 Astra Solves ~100% of Software Reverse Engineering Benchmark (SRE-Bench)
items.body: Researchers reported GPT-6 Astra effectively maxed out SRE-Bench with nearly 100% pass@4 accuracy on software reverse-engineering tasks.

items.title: @qinzytech: Analysis Explores 'Looped Transformers' Architecture Behind Astra
items.body: Research highlights how recursive layer looping decouples reasoning depth from raw parameter memory capacity, enabling extreme token efficiency.

items.title: @theo: Fable 5.1 and Astra Build Developer Confidence for Autonomous PR Merges
items.body: Developer Theo shared that the reliability of Fable 5.1 and Astra allows engineers to delegate end-to-end bug fixes directly to main branches.

items.title: @georgepickett: First-Principles Refactoring Prompt Maximizes Astra Cleanups
items.body: Engineers shared an effective first-principles prompt instructing Astra to delete unnecessary complexity before optimizing remaining codebase architecture.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: August Jobs Surge Triples Forecasts, Shifting Rate Hike Expectations
items.body: US employment data surprised markets with robust job creation, prompting economists to project a potential 25 bps rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: MicroStrategy Bitcoin Holdings Reach $4.93 Billion Unrealized Profit
items.body: Michael Saylor's treasury strategy saw paper gains approach $5 billion as Bitcoin price gains continue to bolster $MSTR balance sheet value.

items.title: @comma_ai: Comma.ai Releases Comma Four Hands-Free Driving Unit for Existing Cars
